claims.text: The three artifacts describe one and the same trip, so the rider's first burden under POL-RD-08 limb (a) is discharged: trip_id TRP-02805 is carried alike by the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare ledger; the trace's first fix at 2026-08-23T16:33:13+08:00 matches trip_record.started_at to the second, its last fix at 16:49:33 matches trip_record.ended_at, and the ledger's charged_at 16:49:58 follows the trip's end. There is no identifier mismatch and no timestamp conflict of the kind POL-RD-10(4) contemplates.

The measurement itself is the platform's own: POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing figure and forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test, and the trace records 12.51 km travelled against the trip record's optimal_distance_km of 11.8 km. The excess is therefore 0.71 km, or 6.0169% of the optimal route — precisely the 12.51 km against 11.8 km the rider's claim states, so the rider's factual narrative is the platform's telemetry and not an estimate.

The trace carrying that measurement is clean and cannot be attacked: 99 fixes at a 10 s interval against an expected interval of 10 s, coverage 100.0%, an empty gaps list, max_gap_sec 0.0, and admissibility COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0. No limb of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met, so the trace is not impaired for policy purposes, no discount under POL-GEN-02 attaches to it, and the trace-integrity escalation route in POL-RD-10(3) is closed. Whatever route was driven is the driver's own recorded route.

The fare ledger charges the route actually driven, which is why the rider noticed a higher-than-normal fare: distance_charge 9.38 SGD for 12.5 km at 0.75 SGD/km and time_charge 4.56 SGD for 16.3 min at 0.28 SGD/min, on top of the 3.80 SGD base fare and the 0.80 SGD platform fee, giving charged_total 18.54 SGD. The only multiplier on those lines is surge_multiplier 1.0, read from the fare_breakdown, and there is no ERP line, no toll, no airport surcharge and no promo; the whole of the difference the rider complains of is distance and time on the 12.51 km the trace records, and the driver took that route at his own hand.

The rider does not stretch the point, and this one is conceded: on the governing trace figure the excess of 0.71 km fails both limbs of the POL-RD-01 establishment test — it is not greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, and 6.0169% is not greater than 20% of the 11.8 km optimal — and because both tests must pass, no route deviation is established on this record and no POL-RD-02 recomputation runs. The rider presses no remedy the policy does not provide. What the concession does not do is supply the driver with an explanation: the extra 0.71 km is measured, and it is unexplained.

The driver's answer — 'I followed the navigation' — cites no artifact and no clause, and under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded; it also cannot be reconciled with the platform's own measurement, because a driver who had followed the routing engine's route would have recorded 11.8 km, not the 12.51 km the trace records. Any explanation the driver wishes to give must come from an artifact, and none supporting his account is on file.

No external traffic cause can be made out on this record. EV-ADVIS-02805-01 is MISSING — the bundle's own note records that no advisory covers the Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3 corridor in this window — and it carries weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so it carries no fact and its absence is itself citable under POL-GEN-02. POL-RD-03 requires an advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses, with a validity window and a shortest lawful alternative from which the 130% cap can be computed; none of those can be read from the bundle, so no part of the 0.71 km is exonerated and no closure-adjusted optimal exists for any recomputation. Under POL-RD-13 an uncited traffic excuse carries no weight and supplies no amended optimal.

There is no chat log to support a rider-requested detour: EV-CHAT-02805 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and contains 0 messages, with first_message_at and last_message_at null and truncated false. POL-RD-04 requires an instruction from the rider identifying a place or road specifically enough to act on, corroborated by the trace passing within 200 m of chat_message.waypoint_hint; with no messages there is no instruction and no waypoint_hint, so the clause is unavailable, no distance can be excluded as rider-requested, and the rider gave no such instruction on this trip.

Nor can any relocation or pooling clause re-base the optimal route: neither pickup_amended_at nor dropoff_amended_at is set on the trip record, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null, so POL-RD-05 has no amended endpoint to re-quote; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, with solo_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-12 has no matched pooled itinerary to substitute. The baseline for POL-RD-01 remains the booked optimal of 11.8 km, exactly as the rider's claim assumes.

The rider's own record is of the kind POL-RD-08 recognises and imposes no extra burden: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the clause's requirement that a claim with excess below 30% be corroborated beyond the gps_trace is not engaged — the rider has no pattern of unsubstantiated route claims. The rider's remaining profile fields (prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld, rating, account_age_days, lifetime_trips) are CONTEXT ONLY under POL-GEN-01 and may not be used to carry any adverse finding against her.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this is a rider-filed route-deviation dispute over SGD 2.00 on trip TRP-02805. The outcome is NO_ACTION. The fare as charged, SGD 18.54, stands, and nothing is returned to the rider; the payment records (EV-FARE-02805: payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) are left exactly as they are.

Why no deviation exists. POL-RD-01 makes the GPS trace the governing measurement and forbids citing the trip record's rounded copy for the threshold test. The trace (EV-GPS-02805, status COMPLETE, weight 1.0) records trace_distance_km 12.51; the platform's booked optimal route (EV-TRIP-02805) is 11.8 km. That is an excess of 0.71 km, or 6.02% of optimal. A deviation is ESTABLISHED only if the excess is greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km. 0.71 km is below 0.8 km and 6.02% is below 20%, so both gates fail and no deviation exists however the trip is characterised. The platform's own derived status for the trace is 'no deviation'. Both sides read the numbers this way: the rider's own filing concedes the threshold is not met, and the driver's advocate reaches the same figure from the same trace. The rider's point that 0.71 km is measured and unexplained is correct, but the policy gives no refund for an unexplained extra 0.71 km that clears neither gate.

Burden (POL-RD-08). The rider's limb (a) is discharged: the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare ledger all carry TRP-02805, and the trace's first and last fixes (16:33:13 and 16:49:33) match trip_record.started_at and ended_at. Limb (b) is not discharged, because the excess she must show does not meet the POL-RD-01 threshold. The burden therefore never shifts to the driver, and no exculpatory clause has to be resolved on his behalf. The driver's statement, 'I followed the navigation', cites no evidence ID and no clause, and carries no weight under POL-RD-08; the ruling does not need it, and no adverse finding is made against him on it.

Fare arithmetic (POL-RD-02). The recomputation clause opens only where a deviation is established, and none is, so it does not run. For completeness on the figures: charged_total was 18.54; a POL-RD-02 recomputation on these inputs gives recomputed_fare 17.9020, a difference of 0.65 — below the SGD 2.00 the rider contested and not payable here because the threshold has not been met.

Pass-through lines (POL-RD-09). Nothing is collectable: no ERP gantry was charged (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00) and no airport surcharge was charged (airport_surcharge 0.00) on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. The lines that remain — base fare 3.80, distance 9.38, time 4.56, platform fee 0.80 — are ordinary card amounts with counterparts in the trip record, so there is no phantom or unmatched line, no billing-integrity finding under POL-RD-09(4), and no referral.

Other clauses raised. POL-RD-03 / POL-RD-13: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02805-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so it can carry no fact and its absence is itself citable; but no party asserts an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is not invoked, no distance is exonerated and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. POL-RD-04: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02805) is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and holds 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint; the clause is unavailable and no distance is excluded as rider-requested. POL-RD-05: neither pickup_amended_at nor dropoff_amended_at is set and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so there is no amended endpoint to re-quote. POL-RD-12: vehicle_type is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so there is no pooled itinerary in play. POL-RD-06: materiality requires an excess above 50% or 8.0 km; it is not reached, so the profile check is not engaged and no driver-conduct referral arises — and in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 172 completed trips, so no pattern could be established on the only field paths that clause permits. POL-GEN-01: every profile field other than the named counters is context only; the rider's rating, account age and prior-dispute figures were not used as grounds for anything, and the driver's profile was used only for the POL-RD-06 test it names.

Confidence and escalation. The deciding fact — the two distances — rests on EV-GPS-02805 and EV-TRIP-02805, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is capped at 1.0 and is set at 0.95. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): 99 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps list and max_gap_sec 0.0, so the trace supplies the deciding measurement at full weight and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises. No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: identifiers and timestamps agree, no exculpatory clause is asserted against a missing artifact, the computed refund does not approach SGD 150.00, no charge line is without a counterpart, and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. This case is therefore decided on the numbers rather than sent to a human reviewer.

The monetary effect is zero, which is below the execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically; either party may appeal it once under POL-GEN-04.

Both of you: this dispute turns on the measured route, and on the measured route the claim fails.

THE FIGURES. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02805, weight 1.0) records 12.51 km travelled. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02805, weight 1.0) records the booked optimal route as 11.8 km. The excess is 0.71 km, which is 6.02% of the optimal route. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms AND greater than 20% of the optimal distance; both tests must pass. 0.71 km fails the absolute gate and 6.02% fails the percentage gate, so no route deviation is established on this trip — exactly what the platform's own derived status ('no deviation') records. POL-RD-01 is explicit that where either test fails the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip.

ruling.explanation:
Outcome: the fare stands. The rider's dispute of SGD 2.00 is not supported by the evidence, so the SGD 18.54 already charged is left in place. No refund is issued to the rider and no compensation is paid to the driver.

Why. POL-RD-01 measures a deviation on the GPS trace, 12.51 km, which is the governing figure — the 12.5 km on the trip record is a rounded convenience copy and may not be cited for the threshold test — against the booked optimal route of 11.8 km. The excess is 0.71 km, or 6.02% of the optimal route. A deviation is established only if the excess is BOTH more than 20% of the optimal route (2.36 km on these figures) AND more than 0.8 km in absolute terms. It is neither. No deviation therefore exists on this trip and POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION however the trip felt to the rider. Because no deviation is established, POL-RD-02 never runs: for transparency only, run against the booked optimal it would have produced a recomputed fare of 17.9020 against the charged total of 18.54, i.e. 0.65, and the ruling must not move that money.

The trace is sound: 99 fixes at a 10-second interval against an expected 10 s, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps list and max gap 0.0 s, admissibility COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0. None of the POL-RD-07(a) to (c) impairment limbs is met, so there is no data failure, no discount under POL-GEN-02, and no trace-integrity escalation under POL-RD-07 / POL-RD-10(3). The measurement has to be met on its numbers, and the numbers are those both sides cite.

Nothing else in the bundle moves money. The fare ledger is complete and reconciles (base 3.80 + distance 9.38 + time 4.56 + platform fee 0.80 = 18.54 charged), with no ERP gantries, no tolls and no airport surcharge, so there is no phantom or unmatched line and POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to correct. The chat log contains 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour can be made out under POL-RD-04; neither pickup_amended_at nor dropoff_amended_at is set and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot re-base the optimal route; and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 supplies no matched-itinerary baseline. No traffic advisory covers this trip — EV-ADVIS-02805-01 is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 — so no closure or other external traffic cause can exonerate any part of the route, and no party in fact asserted one; the driver's answer, 'I followed the navigation', cites no artifact and under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence carries no weight. That point is not decisive either way here, because the rider's own measured excess never clears the gate and the burden never shifted to the driver. The trip identifiers and timestamps on the trip record, the trace and the fare ledger agree, so no POL-RD-10(4) conflict arises, and every charge line has a counterpart in the trace or the trip record, so POL-RD-10(8) does not fire.

The profile claims were considered and decide nothing. POL-RD-06's pattern check is not engaged — there is no material deviation (6.02% and 0.71 km against the 50% / 8.0 km materiality gates) and the evidence is not finely balanced — and it would in any case find nothing, since driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 172 completed trips in 90 days. There is accordingly no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral, which is why the referrals list is empty. The rider's rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d of 0 means the extra-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08 is not engaged. All other profile fields mentioned on either side are CONTEXT ONLY under POL-GEN-01 and none was used as a ground of decision.

Confidence is 0.90. The deciding measurement is carried by the GPS trace and the trip record, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the cap is 1.0 and the ruling is well above the 0.70 escalation floor. The monetary effect is nil and so is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

To the rider and the driver: the complaint is that the trip ran 12.51 km against a usual-route distance of 11.8 km. Both figures are on the record — 12.51 km is gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-02805 and 11.8 km is trip_record.optimal_distance_km on EV-TRIP-02805 — and the platform's own derived excess is 0.71 km, or 6.02% of the optimal route. POL-RD-01 establishes a route deviation only when the excess is BOTH more than 0.8 km in absolute terms AND more than 20% of the optimal distance. 0.71 km is short of 0.8 km, and 6.02% is short of 20%. Both tests must pass, so no deviation is established on this trip and the outcome is NO_ACTION: charged_total of SGD 18.54 stands and nothing is returned. Because the gate fails, the POL-RD-02 recomputation never opens; the driver's arithmetic (charged_total 18.54 less a recomputed_fare of 17.9020, i.e. SGD 0.65) is correct as far as it goes but cannot ground an award, and equally no line of the fare ledger supports the SGD 2.00 the rider contests. The rider's measured excess is confirmed by the same telemetry the rider cites, so the finding is not a credibility finding against either party — the trace simply does not clear the threshold. On evidence quality: EV-GPS-02805 carries 99 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps list and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, all at weight 1.0, so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises; EV-TRIP-02805 and EV-FARE-02805 are likewise at weight 1.0, and the identifiers and timestamps on all three agree. The bundle holds no traffic advisory — EV-ADVIS-02805-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — and that absence is itself citable, but it changes nothing: no party invoked a road-closure exoneration under POL-RD-03, so there is nothing for the absence to defeat, and under POL-RD-13 a missing advisory does not escalate a case decided on the threshold. The driver's answer, 'I followed the navigation', cites no artifact and carries no weight; it is also moot, since the measurement itself shows no deviation. EV-CHAT-02805 contains 0 messages, so there is no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 and no driver admission; vehicle_type is RYDE_X and no endpoint was amended, so POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 have nothing to re-base. No ERP gantry and no airport surcharge were charged and the ledger reconciles, so POL-RD-09(4) yields the rider nothing and no billing-integrity referral is produced. No driver compensation arises either: the fare billed 12.5 km against a trace of 12.51 km, a shortfall of 0.01 km, far below the 1.0 km POL-RD-04 requires. POL-RD-06 is not engaged (the excess is neither 50% of optimal nor 8.0 km, so there is no material deviation and no finely balanced evidence), and in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 172 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern exists; the rider's deviation_claims_60d is 0, so POL-RD-08's extra-corroboration condition does not apply. The profile fields both sides mention are context only under POL-GEN-01 and carried nothing in this ruling. No POL-RD-10 trigger fired, so there is no escalation; the monetary effect is zero and therefore below the execution threshold, so nothing is held and nothing executes.
